title: 13 Best Herbal Creams For Dental Plaque
intro: Herbal creams for dental plaque are topical treatments that contain natural ingredients, such as herbs and essential oils, to combat the buildup of bacteria and plaque on teeth. These creams benefit oral health by reducing inflammation, preventing the formation of tartar, and freshening breath, making them a popular alternative to traditional mouthwashes and toothpastes. Examples of herbal creams used to treat dental plaque include clove oil-based creams, which contain antibacterial properties to kill bacteria and prevent plaque buildup, tea tree oil-based creams, which have antiseptic properties to reduce inflammation and prevent infection, and aloe vera-based creams, which soothe and calm the gums while reducing inflammation. Additionally, other herbal creams such as eucalyptus, peppermint, and chamomile-based creams are also used to treat dental plaque due to their antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties that help prevent plaque buildup and promote healthy gums.

preparations.preparation_desc: Eucalyptus globulus creams are a popular herbal preparation used to treat dental plaque, a bacterial buildup on teeth that can lead to gum inflammation and other oral health issues. The properties of these creams that help to treat this ailment include their antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which work together to reduce the growth of bacteria and soothe inflamed gums. The bioactive constituents of Eucalyptus globulus, including flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, help to inhibit the growth of bacteria and reduce inflammation, making it easier to remove dental plaque. The benefits of using Eucalyptus globulus creams to treat dental plaque include reduced inflammation, improved oral hygiene, and a lower risk of developing gum disease and other oral health problems.
preparations.preparation_study: According to the study in the Journal of oral science, eucalyptus extract (specifically Eucalyptus globulus) containing chewing gum significantly reduced dental plaque formation.

preparations.preparation_desc: Melaleuca alternifolia creams have been traditionally used to treat dental plaque, a common condition characterized by the accumulation of bacteria on the teeth. The properties of Melaleuca alternifolia creams, including their antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, help to treat this ailment by reducing the growth of bacteria and soothing irritated gums. The bioactive constituents, such as cymene and pinene, in Melaleuca alternifolia creams are responsible for their antimicrobial activity, which helps to break down and remove the bacterial plaque. The benefits of using Melaleuca alternifolia creams to treat dental plaque include reduced inflammation, improved gum health, and a fresher breath, making it a natural and effective solution for this common dental issue.

Rosmarinus officinalis creams have been traditionally used to treat dental plaque due to their antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which help to combat the bacterial growth responsible for this condition. The bioactive constituents, including carnosic acid and rosmarinic acid, exhibit potent antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, thereby reducing the severity of dental plaque. These creams help to treat dental plaque by inhibiting the growth of bacteria such as Streptococcus mutans and reducing the production of volatile sulfur compounds, which contribute to bad breath. The benefits of using Rosmarinus officinalis creams to treat dental plaque include reduced inflammation, improved gum health, and a fresher breath, making them a promising natural alternative to conventional treatments.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "PloS one", Rosmarinus officinalis creams for dental plaque showed effective antibacterial and antibiofilm activity, with a minimum inhibitory concentration (MIC) ranging from 0.08-5.00 mg ml-1 against certain oral bacteria.

preparations.preparation_desc: Salvia officinalis creams have been traditionally used to treat dental plaque due to their antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. These creams contain bioactive constituents such as ursolic acid, camphor, and thymol, which help to inhibit the growth of bacteria and fungi that contribute to plaque formation. By reducing inflammation and microbial activity, Salvia officinalis creams help to prevent the progression of dental plaque and promote a healthy oral environment. The benefits of using Salvia officinalis creams to treat dental plaque include reduced risk of tooth decay, gum disease, and bad breath, making it a natural and effective alternative to conventional treatments.

Curcuma longa creams have been traditionally used to treat dental plaque, a bacterial accumulation on teeth leading to inflammation and infection. The anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties of Curcuma longa creams help to reduce the formation of dental plaque by inhibiting the growth of pathogenic bacteria. The bioactive constituents, including curcumin, demethoxycurcumin, and bisdemethoxycurcumin, exhibit potent antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities, making them effective in treating dental plaque. The benefits of using Curcuma longa creams include reduced inflammation, prevented bacterial growth, and improved oral health, making them a promising natural remedy for treating dental plaque.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Brazilian journal of biology = Revista brasleira de biologia", Curcuma longa creams for dental plaque showed moderate activity against oral bacterial pathogens.

preparations.preparation_desc: Zingiber officinale creams, derived from the rhizome of the ginger plant, possess anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties that help to treat dental plaque, a common condition characterized by the accumulation of bacteria and food particles on teeth. The bioactive constituents of this herbal preparation, including gingerols and shogaols, exhibit strong inhibitory effects against the growth of oral pathogens, thereby preventing the formation of dental plaque. The use of Zingiber officinale creams has been found to reduce inflammation and prevent the progression of periodontal diseases, making it a valuable adjunct to conventional oral hygiene practices. The benefits of using Zingiber officinale creams to treat dental plaque include reduced gingivitis, improved oral health, and a lower risk of developing more severe periodontal diseases.

Thymus vulgaris creams, derived from the herb thyme, have been used to treat dental plaque due to their antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents, including thymol and carvacrol, help to inhibit the growth of bacteria and reduce inflammation in the gums, thus aiding in the treatment of dental plaque. By applying Thymus vulgaris creams to the affected area, individuals can experience relief from symptoms such as redness, swelling, and pain associated with dental plaque. The benefits of using Thymus vulgaris creams to treat dental plaque include reduced risk of gum disease, improved oral health, and a decrease in the need for invasive dental procedures.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Journal of dentistry (Shiraz, Iran)", Thymus vulgaris creams for dental plaque using thymus vulgaris essential oil can be considered as an alternative to 0.2% chlorhexidine to eliminate fungal contamination of orthodontic appliances, which are prone to accumulating C. albicans.

preparations.preparation_desc: Cymbopogon citratus creams, derived from the East Indian lemon grass plant, have been traditionally used to treat dental plaque and associated ailments. The bioactive constituents of Cymbopogon citratus creams, including citral, geraniol, and limonene, exhibit potent antibacterial and antioxidant activities, which contribute to its therapeutic effects against dental plaque. Regular use of Cymbopogon citratus creams may help prevent the formation of dental plaque, reduce the risk of associated gum diseases, and promote overall oral well-being.

The benefits of using Lavandula angustifolia creams to treat dental plaque include reduced inflammation, prevention of further bacterial growth, and promotion of overall oral health and hygiene.

Mentha x piperita creams, derived from the peppermint plant, have been traditionally used to treat dental plaque, a bacterial biofilm that causes tooth decay and gum disease. The antibacterial and anti-inflammatory properties of Mentha x piperita creams help to inhibit the growth of bacteria and reduce inflammation in the oral cavity, effectively treating the dental plaque ailment. The bioactive constituents of Mentha x piperita creams, including menthol, menthone, and limonene, contribute to its therapeutic effects by disrupting bacterial cell membranes and reducing oxidative stress. The use of Mentha x piperita creams to treat dental plaque offers several benefits, including reduced bacterial load, decreased inflammation, and improved oral health, making it a valuable natural remedy for this common ailment.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Avicenna journal of phytomedicine", Mentha x piperita creams for dental plaque were found to have significant effects in decomposing the teeth biofilm in 45 seconds and deforming the bacterial structure.

preparations.preparation_desc: Echinacea purpurea creams have been used as a natural remedy to treat dental plaque, a common bacterial infection that causes inflammation and damage to the gums and teeth. By using Echinacea purpurea creams, individuals can benefit from its natural and non-invasive approach to treating dental plaque, promoting healthy gums and teeth, and reducing the risk of more severe oral health complications.

preparations.preparation_study: According to the study published in the Journal of International Society of Preventive & Community Dentistry, Aloe barbadensis creams have excellent applications in treating periodontal diseases, specifically by inhibiting primary plaque colonizers and periodontal pathogens.

preparations.preparation_study: According to the Journal of International Society of Preventive & Community Dentistry, Glycyrrhiza glabra creams for dental plaque are effective in inhibiting primary plaque colonizers and periodontal pathogens due to their antibacterial property, which helps maintain acid-alkali balance in saliva.
